facts.fact: A SADCAS accreditation certificate dated 14 December 2025 describes the Malawi Bureau of Standards as established by the Malawi Bureau of Standards Act (Cap 51:02); it names no national standard on information technology or data.

systems.system: Malawi Bureau of Standards, Quality Management Systems Certification (QMS-CERT-003)

note: No certification fact: SADCAS accredits MBS to certify quality management systems only (ISO/IEC 17021-1 and -3; scope food, rubber and plastics, transport and storage), not against an IT or data standard.
